k:住.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who is master (主) of a house: he lights the lamp, hangs up his coat and settles in. This is where he lives. Dwell (reside, live, inhabit).

k:阪.mnemonic: A mound (阝) that is anti- (反) walker: it pushes back against your legs with every step up its steep slope. Heights (slope).

k:角.mnemonic: An animal's horn, ridged along its length and coming to a sharp point at the top: a pointed corner. Angle (corner, horn, square).

k:解.mnemonic: A cow (牛) is tangled up in rope. Find the right angle (角), slip a sword (刀) under the knot, and the whole tangle falls away. Solve (untie, explain, unravel).
k:解.hint: Freeing a cow from a knot.

k:具.mnemonic: An eye (目) over one (一) workbench with legs like fins (ハ): the craftsman looks across his kit, laid out and ready. Tool (utensil, means, possess).

k:乗.mnemonic: Ten thousand (万) stalks of grain (禾) are piled on a cart, and you climb up and sit on top of the load all the way to market. Ride (power, multiplication, board).
k:乗.hint: Sitting on top of the grain cart.

k:真.mnemonic: Check it with ten (十) different tools (具), ruler, scale and level. If all ten agree, it is real. True (reality, genuine, truth).

k:走.mnemonic: A figure with arms flung out above and legs in a long stride below, one foot kicking forward. Run.

k:起.mnemonic: A cobra (已) rears up beside your bed, and you are up and on the run (走) before your eyes are even open. Rouse (wake up, get up).

k:着.mnemonic: An eye (目) looks up at a sheep (羊) and sees a coat: shear the wool, pull it over your head and you are dressed. Don (arrive, wear, come).
k:着.hint: Seeing a coat on a sheep.

k:査.mnemonic: An inspector's eye (目) pressed close to an open book (本), going down every line of the accounts to find what does not add up. Investigate (inspect).
k:査.hint: An eye going through the books.

k:打.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) hold a hook (亅) shaped nail steady while the hammer comes down on its flat head. Hit (strike, knock, pound).

k:果.mnemonic: A tree (木) with something shaped like a rice field (田) on top: one big round ball divided into segments, the result of a year's growing. Fruit (result, reward, carry out).
k:果.hint: A segmented ball atop a tree.

k:惑.mnemonic: A sweet-talking mouth (口) hides a halberd (戈) behind its back and works on your heart (心). You are charmed and cannot tell what is real. Beguile (delusion, perplexity).

k:感.mnemonic: To beguile (惑) someone, slide (ノ) a little something past their guard. It lands inside them as a shiver, a pang. Feeling (sense, sensation, emotion).
k:感.hint: A shiver slipped past the guard.

k:兄.mnemonic: A big mouth (口) on legs (儿): the one who walks around telling the younger ones what to do. Elder brother (big brother).

k:党.mnemonic: Elder brother (兄) wears a sparkle (⺌) of badges on a band across his forehead (冖). He has joined a faction and wants everyone to know. Party (faction, clique).

k:路.mnemonic: Each leg (足) will trudge (夂) the same way every day until the grass is worn through: a track from here to there. Route (path, road, distance).
k:路.hint: A track worn by daily walking.

k:斗.mnemonic: A ladle with a long handle and two drops inside its bowl, like the ladle of seven stars in the northern sky. Big Dipper (sake dipper).

k:科.mnemonic: Grain (禾) is scooped with a ladle shaped like the Big Dipper (斗) and sorted into separate bins by kind. Every kind has its own section. Department (course, section, division).
k:科.hint: Grain sorted into bins by kind.

k:急.mnemonic: Guests are at the gate! You snatch the broom (ヨ), sweep round the cradle (勹), and your heart (心) pounds. Hurry (emergency, sudden, steep).

k:改.mnemonic: Strike (攵) the ground beside a cobra (已) and it mends its ways at once: it uncoils, lowers its hood and behaves. Reformation (change, modify, mend).

k:九.mnemonic: A bent arm with a hooked elbow, reaching out to grab one more but stopping just short of ten. Nine.

k:親.mnemonic: Standing up in a tree (木), a mother can see (見) her child reaching for the spicy (辛) peppers and shouts a warning. Always watching. Parent (intimacy, relative, familiarity).
k:親.hint: Watching the child from a tree.

k:害.mnemonic: The roof (宀) gives way and soil (土) pours down into your open mouth (口). Even at home you can get hurt. Harm (injury).
k:害.hint: The ceiling caves in on you.

k:由.mnemonic: A shoot pokes out of the top of a rice field (田) and starts to bend (曲) towards the sun. Why does it sprout just there? There must be a reason. Wherefore (a reason).
k:由.hint: Why does the shoot sprout there?

k:鉄.mnemonic: An arrow (矢) tipped with gold (金) just bends on the target. The metal you want for an arrowhead is the hard grey one. Iron.

k:夜.mnemonic: The leader (亻) stays up long past evening (夕), a lid of darkness over his head, keeping watch until dawn. Night (evening).

k:片.mnemonic: A tree split down the middle with only the right-hand piece kept: a single thin slab. One-sided (leaf, sheet).
k:片.hint: The right-hand slab of a split tree.

k:版.mnemonic: A one-sided (片) slab of wood, carved with everything anti- (反), back to front. Press it on paper and the words come out the right way round. Printing block (printing plate, edition, impression).
k:版.hint: A slab carved back to front.
